True def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The divider is a full-width row in a color that appears only on that row.
    cut = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
               if len(set(row)) == 1 and sum(v == row[0] for r in grid for v in r) == w)
    upper, lower = grid[:cut], grid[cut + 1:]
    shared = set(v for r in upper for v in r) & set(v for r in lower for v in r)
    background = max(shared, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for r in upper + lower for v in r))
    # Mark aligned matches of the shared background; all other cells remain that color.
    return [[3 if a == background and b == background else background
             for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(upper, lower)]
